note: Multiple Selects is a single field-widget module (plugin id multiple_options_select, class OptionsMultipleSelectWidget extends core's OptionsSelectWidget). Its @FieldWidget annotation restricts it to field_types = {entity_reference, list_integer, list_float, list_string}. There is no settings form of its own, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush commands, and it defines no new plugin type -- it only supplies an instance of core's field_widget plugin type. Its only persistent state is the widget assignment itself (type: multiple_options_select) plus its one setting, element_type (select or select2, if the select2 module is installed), stored on a component inside an entity_form_display config entity. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config, using a namespaced content type (msel_ct) and namespaced fields (field_msel_*) created and torn down by the eval scripts so this campaign's site stays isolated from other modules' fixtures: introspection reads back which field/widget is assigned; execution assigns the multiple_options_select widget to a field's default form display and verifies the live entity_form_display component.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module multiple_selects provides a field widget called 'Multiple select list(s)' (plugin id multiple_options_select). Per its @FieldWidget annotation, which field types can this widget be assigned to?
evals.expected_output: Its field_types annotation lists entity_reference, list_integer, list_float, and list_string -- so it can only be assigned to widgets on those four field types (and only shows its distinguishing per-delta behavior when the field's cardinality is greater than 1).

evals.prompt: I want a multi-value list_string field to show one plain dropdown per value instead of one multi-select box, using the multiple_selects module. What widget plugin do I assign on Manage form display, and where does Drupal store that choice?
evals.expected_output: Assign the 'Multiple select list(s)' widget (plugin id multiple_options_select) to the field on the bundle's Manage form display page. The choice is stored as the component's type in the entity_form_display config entity, e.g. core.entity_form_display.<entity_type>.<bundle>.<form_mode> -> content.<field_name>.type: multiple_options_select, alongside its settings.element_type value.

evals.prompt: The multiple_options_select widget has one setting, element_type. What does it control, what must be true for 'select2' to appear as an option, and how does the widget represent 'no value chosen' differently for a plain select versus select2?
evals.expected_output: element_type chooses the render element type for each per-delta widget: 'select' (always available) or 'select2' (only offered in settingsForm() if the select2 module is installed, checked via $module_handler->moduleExists('select2')). A plain select's empty placeholder value is the string '_none'; select2's is an empty string ''. The widget's isEmptyValue() treats both as empty and normalizes them to NULL on validation.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type msel_ct has a multi-value list field. Inspect the live default form display for msel_ct and give the machine name of the field that uses the Multiple Selects module's widget (plugin id multiple_options_select).
evals.expected_output: The field is field_msel_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.msel_ct.default its component has type: multiple_options_select.

evals.prompt: Content type msel_ct on this site has two multi-value list_string fields, field_msel_multi and field_msel_single. Exactly one of them uses the Multiple Selects module's widget (multiple_options_select) on its default form display; the other uses core's plain multi-select widget (options_select). Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field uses the Multiple Selects widget.
evals.expected_output: field_msel_multi uses the Multiple Selects widget: in core.entity_form_display.node.msel_ct.default its component has type: multiple_options_select, whereas field_msel_single's component has type: options_select (core's default).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, content type msel_ct has a multi-value entity reference field field_msel_task (referencing users, unlimited cardinality) currently using core's plain 'Select list' widget. Using the multiple_selects module, change its default form display widget to the Multiple Selects widget (multiple_options_select) so editors get one select per value. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.msel_ct.default the field_msel_task component's type is changed to multiple_options_select (e.g. via the field's widget dropdown on Manage form display, or by loading the entity_form_display, calling setComponent('field_msel_task', ['type' => 'multiple_options_select', ...]) and saving).

evals.prompt: Content type msel_ct has a list_string field field_msel_conf with a fixed cardinality of 4 allowed values, currently using core's plain multi-select widget (options_select). Use the multiple_selects module to switch its default form display widget to 'Multiple select list(s)' (multiple_options_select), so editors see four individual per-value dropdowns instead of one multi-select box. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.msel_ct.default the field_msel_conf component's type is changed to multiple_options_select. Because field_msel_conf has fixed cardinality 4, the widget renders exactly four per-delta selects with no 'Add another item' button.
